name: Use the simulated market chart and shared demo prices
covers: shared market feed with demo terminal
description: Verifies the free simulated chart displays candles and indicators and the demo terminal consumes the shared practice prices.
steps: Open Market and view the EUR/USD simulated candlestick chart
Observe the practice price and indicator values
Open Demo trading and confirm the selected pair has a shared practice price that updates automatically
expected: The chart shows simulated candles, RSI and a moving average; the demo terminal displays automatically updating practice prices and clearly labels them as simulated.

name: Start with a clean journal and save a practice trade
description: Verifies a first-time learner sees no invented trading history and can save a real practice journal entry.
steps: Open Overview with no saved journal entries
Open Trade journal and add a EUR/USD Buy practice trade with valid values
Save the trade and refresh the page
expected: The saved EUR/USD practice trade remains visible after refresh and the overview reflects the journal entry.

name: Calculate approximate position size from risk inputs
description: Verifies risk inputs update the estimate and assumptions remain visible.
steps: Set balance to 10000, risk to 1 percent and stop distance to 20 pips
expected: Cash risk shows $100.00, suggested size is approximately 0.50 lots, and pip-value assumptions are disclosed.

name: Reject invalid practice trade values on mobile
description: Verifies invalid prices are rejected without adding a journal entry.
steps: Choose Add trade, clear entry price and submit
expected: A validation message appears and no invalid trade is added.

name: Complete Academy lessons and retain progress
description: Verifies learners can study lessons, mark them complete and retain progress.
expected: Lesson 01 remains completed and progress displays one of twelve lessons.
